<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Idee Infotech – Quotation Generator</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#f6f7fb;--card:#fff;--tx:#1b1f2a;--mu:#667085;--ac:#1646c8;--bd:#e3e6ee;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#14161c;--card:#1d2029;--tx:#eef0f6;--mu:#98a0b3;--ac:#4f8bff;--bd:#2d3140}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font:15px/1.4 system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;padding:12px 12px 90px}
.w{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto}
h1{font-size:20px;margin:6px 0 2px}h2{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--ac)}
.s{color:var(--mu);font-size:13px;margin:0 0 12px}
.c{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
@media(max-width:560px){.g{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
input,select,textarea{width:100%;padding:9px;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font:inherit}
label.f{font-size:12px;color:var(--mu);display:block;margin-bottom:3px}
.r{display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 1fr 78px 52px 78px;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--bd)}
.r input[type=number]{padding:6px}.r input[type=checkbox]{width:18px;height:18px}
.n small{display:block;color:var(--mu);font-size:11px}
.t{text-align:right;font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
.bar{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:var(--card);border-top:1px solid var(--bd);padding:10px 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.bar b{font-size:17px}
button{background:var(--ac);color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:11px 18px;font:600 15px inherit;font-family:inherit}
.hd{display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 1fr 78px 52px 78px;gap:6px;font-size:11px;color:var(--mu)}
</style></head><body><div class="w">
<h1>IDEE INFOTECH – Quotation Generator</h1>
<p class="s">Customer details fill pannunga, services select pannunga, Submit kudutha PDF download aagum.</p>

<div class="c"><h2>Company settings (oru thadava mattum)</h2><div class="g">
<div><label class="f">Change logo (optional)</label><input id="lg" type="file" accept="image/*" src="images/logo.png"><span class="s" id="lp" style="margin:4px 0 0;display:block"></span></div>
<div><label class="f">Sales person</label><input id="sp"></div>
<div><label class="f">Company address</label><input id="sa" value="Near Four Road, Kolathur - 636 303"></div>
<div><label class="f">GSTIN</label><input id="sg"></div>
<div><label class="f">Validity (days)</label><input id="vd" type="number" value="15"></div>
</div></div>

<div class="c"><h2>Customer details (Bill To)</h2><div class="g">
<div><label class="f">Customer name *</label><input id="cn"></div>
<div><label class="f">Phone *</label><input id="cp" type="tel"></div>
<div><label class="f">Email</label><input id="ce" type="email"></div>
<div><label class="f">Business / Company</label><input id="cb"></div>
</div><div style="margin-top:8px"><label class="f">Address</label><input id="ca"></div>
<div style="margin-top:8px"><label class="f">Project / Notes</label><textarea id="cm" rows="2"></textarea></div></div>

<div id="svc"></div>

<div class="c"><h2>Extras</h2><div class="g">
<div><label class="f">Urgent delivery surcharge</label><select id="ur"><option value="0">None</option><option value="25">25%</option><option value="50">50%</option></select></div>
<div><label class="f">GST</label><select id="gs"><option value="0">Not included</option><option value="18">18% GST</option></select></div>
</div></div>
</div>
<div class="bar"><div><span class="s" style="margin:0">Total</span><br><b id="tot">Rs. 0</b></div><button id="sb">Submit &amp; Download PDF</button></div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf-autotable/3.8.2/jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js"></script>
<script>
const D=[
["Monthly Digital Marketing Packages",[["Starter Package (6 reels, 6 posters, 6 captions, IG & FB posting)",7999,"month"],["Growth Package (12 reels, 12 posters, page optimization, report)",14999,"month"],["Premium Package (20 reels, 20 posters, 20 carousels, Meta Ads)",24999,"month"]]],
["Monthly Video Editing Packages",[["Basic Editing (6 reels)",3000,"month"],["Standard Editing (10 reels)",6000,"month"],["Professional Editing (8 reels)",10000,"month"],["Premium Editing (8 advanced reels)",15000,"month"]]],
["Video Editing",[["Basic Reel Editing (30-60 sec)",500,"video"],["Professional Reel Editing",800,"video"],["Advanced Reel Editing",1500,"video"],["Talking Head Video Editing",800,"video"],["Food / Restaurant Reel",1500,"video"],["Promotional Video Editing",1000,"video"],["YouTube Editing (5-10 min)",2500,"video"],["YouTube Editing (10-20 min)",4500,"video"],["Wedding / Event Highlight",5000,"video"],["Subtitle Addition",300,"video"]]],
["Graphic Design",[["Social Media Poster",300,"poster"],["Promotional Poster",500,"poster"],["Festival Poster",500,"poster"],["Carousel Design (5 slides)",1600,"set"],["Business Card Design",300,"design"],["Flyer Design",1000,"design"],["YouTube Thumbnail",400,"thumbnail"]]],
["Logo & Branding",[["Basic Logo Design",1800,""],["Professional Logo Design",3500,""],["Basic Branding",5000,""],["Complete Brand Identity",9000,""]]],
["Social Media Management",[["Instagram Account Setup",500,""],["Facebook Page Setup",500,""],["Social Media Management",1000,"month"],["Profile Optimization",500,""],["Monthly Performance Report",300,"month"]]],
["Meta Ads",[["Meta Ads Setup",2000,""],["Meta Ads Management",3500,"month"],["Lead Generation Management",5000,"month"],["Ad Creative Design",500,"creative"]]],
["Google Ads",[["Google Ads Setup",2500,""],["Google Ads Management",4500,"month"]]],
["SEO",[["Basic SEO",3000,"month"],["Standard SEO",6000,"month"],["Advanced SEO",11000,"month"],["Website SEO Audit",2000,""],["Keyword Research",1000,""]]],
["Content Writing",[["Social Media Content (caption / short post)",300,"article"],["Blog Article Writing",800,"page"]]],
["Photography & Videography",[["Basic Photography (4 hours)",1500,""],["Product Photography",500,"product"],["Restaurant Photography",4000,""],["Promotional Video Shoot",4000,""],["Reel Shoot",1500,"reel"],["Restaurant Shoot Package",5000,""],["Half-Day Shoot (4 hours)",3000,""],["Full-Day Shoot (8 hours)",6000,""]]],
["Website Design",[["One-Page Website",5000,""],["Business Website (up to 5 pages)",10000,""],["Professional Website (20,000 onwards)",20000,""],["E-commerce Website (18,000 onwards)",18000,""],["Landing Page",3000,""],["Website Maintenance",1500,"month"]]],
["Additional Charges",[["Extra Revision",200,"revision"],["Source Project Files (500 onwards)",500,""],["Extra Shoot Hour",1500,"hour"]]]
];
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),fm=n=>"Rs. "+Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-IN");
let h="";
D.forEach((c,i)=>{h+=`<div class="c"><h2>${c[0]}</h2><div class="hd"><span></span><span>Service</span><span>Rate</span><span>Qty</span><span style="text-align:right">Amount</span></div>`;
c[1].forEach((s,j)=>{const k=i+"_"+j;h+=`<div class="r"><input type="checkbox" id="k${k}"><div class="n">${s[0]}${s[2]?`<small>per ${s[2]}</small>`:""}</div><input type="number" min="0" id="p${k}" value="${s[1]}"><input type="number" min="1" id="q${k}" value="1"><div class="t" id="t${k}">-</div></div>`});h+="</div>"});
$("svc").innerHTML=h;
let LOGO={u:"data:image/png;base64,",w:74,h:20.72};
function qno(){let n=1;try{n=(+localStorage.getItem("qc")||0)+1;localStorage.setItem("qc",n)}catch(e){}const t=new Date(),y=t.getMonth()>=3?t.getFullYear():t.getFullYear()-1;return "IDEE/"+String(y).slice(2)+"-"+String(y+1).slice(2)+"/"+String(n).padStart(4,"0")}
async function saveQ(o){try{const db=await claude.use("db");if(!db)return;await db.collection("quotations").doc(o.no.replace(/\//g,"-")).set(o)}catch(e){}}
const SF=["sa","sg","sp","vd"];
try{SF.forEach(i=>{const v=localStorage.getItem("s_"+i);if(v)$(i).value=v});const l=localStorage.getItem("logo");if(l){LOGO=JSON.parse(l);$("lp").textContent="Idee logo set ✓"}}catch(e){}
SF.forEach(i=>$(i).addEventListener("input",()=>{try{localStorage.setItem("s_"+i,$(i).value)}catch(e){}}));
$("lg").onchange=e=>{const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{const m=Math.min(1,700/im.width),c=document.createElement("canvas");c.width=im.width*m;c.height=im.height*m;c.getContext("2d").drawImage(im,0,0,c.width,c.height);const q=c.width/c.height;let w=64,h=64/q;if(h>24){h=24;w=24*q}LOGO={u:c.toDataURL("image/png"),w:w,h:h};try{localStorage.setItem("logo",JSON.stringify(LOGO))}catch(x){}$("lp").textContent="Logo added ✓"};im.src=r.result};r.readAsDataURL(f)};
function rows(){const o=[];D.forEach((c,i)=>c[1].forEach((s,j)=>{const k=i+"_"+j;if($("k"+k).checked){const p=+$("p"+k).value||0,q=Math.max(1,+$("q"+k).value||1);o.push([s[0]+(s[2]==="month"?" (per month)":""),p,q,p*q])}}));return o}
function calc(){D.forEach((c,i)=>c[1].forEach((s,j)=>{const k=i+"_"+j;$("t"+k).textContent=$("k"+k).checked?fm((+$("p"+k).value||0)*Math.max(1,+$("q"+k).value||1)):"-"}));
const r=rows(),sub=r.reduce((a,x)=>a+x[3],0),u=sub*(+$("ur").value)/100,g=(sub+u)*(+$("gs").value)/100;$("tot").textContent=fm(sub+u+g);return{r,sub,u,g,total:sub+u+g}}
document.addEventListener("input",calc);document.addEventListener("change",calc);calc();
$("sb").onclick=()=>{
if(!$("cn").value.trim()||!$("cp").value.trim()){alert("Customer name and phone fill pannunga.");return}
const v=calc();if(!v.r.length){alert("Kuraindhathu oru service select pannunga.");return}
const {jsPDF}=window.jspdf,d=new jsPDF(),now=new Date(),pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,"0");
const ds=pad(now.getDate())+"-"+pad(now.getMonth()+1)+"-"+now.getFullYear(),no=qno();
const e2=new Date(now.getTime()+(+$("vd").value||15)*864e5),ex=pad(e2.getDate())+"-"+pad(e2.getMonth()+1)+"-"+e2.getFullYear();
const NV=[11,27,61],NV2=[21,46,98],AC=[0,136,238],CY=[43,184,255],TX=[28,32,44],GR=[244,245,248],MU=[105,113,130];
const poly=(p,c)=>{d.setFillColor(...c);d.lines(p.slice(1).map((q,i)=>[q[0]-p[i][0],q[1]-p[i][1]]),p[0][0],p[0][1],[1,1],"F",true)};
d.setFillColor(...NV);d.rect(0,0,210,51,"F");
poly([[0,0],[112,0],[74,45],[0,45]],NV2);poly([[112,0],[210,0],[210,7.2],[106,7.2]],AC);poly([[0,45],[74,45],[82,51],[0,51]],AC);
if(LOGO){const r=LOGO.w/LOGO.h;let w=88,h=w/r;if(h>27){h=27;w=h*r}try{d.addImage(LOGO.u,"PNG",11,23-h/2,w,h)}catch(x){}}else{d.setTextColor(255,255,255);d.setFont("helvetica","bold");d.setFontSize(20);d.text("IDEE INFOTECH",11,26)}
d.setTextColor(...CY);d.setFont("helvetica","bold");d.setFontSize(26);d.text("QUOTATION",198.5,26,{align:"right"});
d.setFontSize(7.5);
[["Quotation Number:",no],["Quotation Date:",ds],["Valid Till:",ex]].forEach((a,i)=>{const yy=32.5+i*5;d.setTextColor(255,255,255);d.setFont("helvetica","bold");d.text(a[0],140,yy);d.setTextColor(205,220,240);d.setFont("helvetica","normal");d.text(a[1],198.5,yy,{align:"right"})});
const L=12,RX=148;
d.setFont("helvetica","bold");d.setFontSize(8);d.setTextColor(...AC);d.text("QUOTATION TO:",L,63);d.text("QUOTATION FROM:",RX,63);
d.setTextColor(...TX);d.setFontSize(15);d.text(d.splitTextToSize($("cn").value,120)[0],L,72);d.setFontSize(12);d.text("Idee Infotech",RX,71.5);
const ln=(x,yy,lab,val,w)=>{if(!val)return yy;d.setFontSize(8.5);d.setTextColor(...TX);let lw=0;if(lab){d.setFont("helvetica","bold");d.text(lab,x,yy);lw=d.getTextWidth(lab+" ")}d.setFont("helvetica","normal");const ls=d.splitTextToSize(val,w-lw);d.text(ls,x+lw,yy);return yy+4.8*ls.length};
let y=78.5,y2=77.5;
y=ln(L,y,"",$("cb").value,110);y=ln(L,y,"",$("ca").value,110);y=ln(L,y,"Phone:",$("cp").value,110);y=ln(L,y,"Email:",$("ce").value,110);
y2=ln(RX,y2,"","Digital Marketing & Creative Services",50);y2=ln(RX,y2,"GSTIN:",$("sg").value,50);y2=ln(RX,y2,"Sales Person:",$("sp").value,50);
y=Math.max(y,y2);if($("cm").value.trim())y=ln(L,y+1,"Notes:",$("cm").value,186);
const cp=(l,r)=>({top:3.6,bottom:3.6,left:l,right:r});
d.autoTable({startY:Math.max(99,y+3),margin:{left:0,right:0,top:15,bottom:22},theme:"plain",head:[["NO.","DESCRIPTION","PRICE","QTY.","TOTAL"]],body:v.r.map((x,i)=>[i+1,x[0],fm(x[1]),x[2],fm(x[3])]),
styles:{fontSize:8.5,textColor:TX,cellPadding:cp(2,2)},headStyles:{fillColor:AC,textColor:255,fontStyle:"bold",fontSize:8},
columnStyles:{0:{cellWidth:32,cellPadding:cp(12,2)},1:{cellWidth:84,cellPadding:cp(8,2)},2:{cellWidth:30,halign:"center"},3:{cellWidth:30,halign:"center"},4:{cellWidth:34,halign:"right",cellPadding:cp(2,11.5)}},
didParseCell:h=>{if(h.section==="body"&&[0,2,4].includes(h.column.index))h.cell.styles.fillColor=GR},
didDrawCell:h=>{if(h.section==="body"){const c=h.cell;d.setDrawColor(232,235,241);d.setLineWidth(.2);d.line(c.x,c.y+c.height,c.x+c.width,c.y+c.height)}}});
let t=d.lastAutoTable.finalY+9;if(t>212){d.addPage();t=22}
const T=[["Subtotal",fm(v.sub)]];if(v.u)T.push(["Urgent ("+$("ur").value+"%)",fm(v.u)]);if(v.g)T.push(["GST ("+$("gs").value+"%)",fm(v.g)]);
let ty=t+2;T.forEach(r=>{d.setFont("helvetica","normal");d.setFontSize(8.5);d.setTextColor(...MU);d.text(r[0],158,ty);d.setFont("helvetica","bold");d.setTextColor(...TX);d.text(r[1],198.5,ty,{align:"right"});ty+=6.2});
d.setFillColor(...AC);d.rect(151,ty-1,59,11.5,"F");d.setTextColor(255,255,255);d.setFont("helvetica","bold");d.setFontSize(10);d.text("Total",158,ty+6.2);d.text(fm(v.total),198.5,ty+6.2,{align:"right"});
d.setTextColor(...TX);d.setFont("helvetica","bold");d.setFontSize(11);d.text("Terms & Conditions:",L,t+4);
d.setFont("helvetica","normal");d.setFontSize(7.5);d.setTextColor(...MU);
const tm=["50% advance payment is required before starting the project; balance is due before final delivery.","Advertising spend, travel, rentals, domain, hosting and third-party costs are extra unless stated in the quotation.","Revisions and deliverables are limited to the agreed scope.","GST / applicable taxes will be charged additionally where applicable.","Final pricing may change based on project complexity, duration and confirmed deliverables."];
let ky=t+10;tm.forEach(x=>{const ls=d.splitTextToSize("- "+x,118);d.text(ls,L,ky);ky+=3.7*ls.length});
const th=ky+6;d.setTextColor(...TX);d.setFont("helvetica","bold");d.setFontSize(11);d.text("Thank You For Your Business",L,th);
const ic=(k,x,yy)=>{d.setFillColor(...AC);d.roundedRect(x,yy,5,5,1,1,"F");d.setFillColor(255,255,255);
if(k==="p"){d.roundedRect(x+1.7,yy+1,1.6,3,.4,.4,"F")}else if(k==="e"){d.rect(x+1,yy+1.4,3,2.2,"F");d.setDrawColor(...AC);d.setLineWidth(.3);d.line(x+1,yy+1.4,x+2.5,yy+2.7);d.line(x+4,yy+1.4,x+2.5,yy+2.7)}else{d.circle(x+2.5,yy+2.2,1.2,"F");d.setFillColor(...AC);d.circle(x+2.5,yy+2.2,.45,"F")}};
let cy=th+6;[["p","7810010572"],["e","ideeinfotech@gmail.com"],["l",$("sa").value]].filter(r=>r[1]).forEach(r=>{ic(r[0],L,cy);d.setFont("helvetica","normal");d.setFontSize(8.5);d.setTextColor(...TX);d.text(d.splitTextToSize(r[1],100)[0],L+8,cy+3.5);cy+=7});
const sy=Math.max(ty+32,th+10);d.setDrawColor(190,195,205);d.setLineWidth(.3);d.line(150,sy,198.5,sy);d.setFont("helvetica","bold");d.setFontSize(8.5);d.setTextColor(...TX);d.text("Authorised Sign",174,sy+5,{align:"center"});
poly([[0,284.6],[90,284.6],[79,297],[0,297]],AC);poly([[88.6,289],[210,289],[210,297],[81.5,297]],NV);
saveQ({no:no,date:ds,valid:ex,name:$("cn").value,phone:$("cp").value,email:$("ce").value,biz:$("cb").value,addr:$("ca").value,notes:$("cm").value,items:v.r.map(x=>x[0]+" x"+x[2]+" @"+x[1]).join("; "),sub:Math.round(v.sub),urgent:Math.round(v.u),gst:Math.round(v.g),total:Math.round(v.total),adv:Math.round(v.total/2),sp:$("sp").value,at:Date.now()});
d.save("Quotation-"+$("cn").value.trim().replace(/\s+/g,"_")+"-"+no.replace(/\//g,"-")+".pdf")};
</script></body></html>
